claims_rejected.why: the demoness turning from cruelty (மறம் மாற்றிய பின்) is narrated, not stated as a doctrine

claims.school_detail: ūḻvinai; the work's own frame endorses it
claims.gist: former deeds (ஊழ்வினை) drove Kovalan to Madurai and his death

claims_rejected.why: the justice of the Chola kings (the dove, the calf and the son crushed under the chariot) is cited as precedent, not stated as a general claim

units.note: Whether Kannaki's ஊழ்வினை துரப்ப is a stated claim or only a turn of phrase in her self-introduction is a close call.

claims_rejected.why: the queen's dream omens (falling umbrella and sceptre, ringing bell, darkened sun) are seen, not a stated claim that omens portend

claims.gist: comparison (உவமம்) is a means of knowledge: knowing the gavaya as like a cow
scripture (ஆகமம்) from the knower's book is a means of knowledge, e.g. that there is a world of enjoyment
presumption (அருத்தாபத்தி) is a means of knowledge: 'the cowherds' village is on the Ganga' means on its bank
nature (இயல்பு) is a means of knowledge: the rider asking for the goad is given that alone
tradition (ஐதிகம்) is a means of knowledge: 'a ghost lives in this tree'
absence (அபாவம்) is a means of knowledge: a thing is not in that place
implication (மீட்சி) is a means of knowledge: 'Rama won' tells that Ravana lost
inclusion (உள்ள நெறி) is a means of knowledge: what draws the iron needle is the magnet

units.note: Manimekalai 27 lays out each school without answering it in the unit, so the stance is reported rather than refuted, though the work later rejects most of these means of knowledge.

claims_rejected.why: the god's driving spirits from land, town and forest is narrated, not stated as a claim

claims.gist: God is the one who binds the eight forms (two lights, the sacrificer, five elements) with soul and body
God creates the world as play and destroys it, removing sorrow
there is nothing other than God apart from himself
no one has known a former birth by reaching it, so former births cannot be known
what seems memory of another life in divine possession or in dreams is only the deluded mind turned otherwise

claims_rejected.why: 'நன்று அல ஆயினும் நான் மாறு உரைக்கிலேன்' is a dismissal of the other schools, not a doctrine

units.note: The speaker turns (என்றலும் at 280 and 283) are hard to assign; I read 279-283 as the materialist and 283 onward as the reply.

claims_rejected.why: Kannaki's 'இறைமுறை பிழைத்தோன்' accuses this king; it is not a general claim about kingship
the poet's plea that the learned not reject a work outside the old āgama is a modesty formula, not a doctrine

claims.gist: primal nature (மூலப் பகுதி) is hard to know, made of three qualities, without mind, common, and the source of all things
from primal nature come buddhi (மான்), then the elements, mind, ego, the senses and organs of action
from the elements arise mountains, trees and the world, which return by the same path into dissolution
primal nature is one, everywhere pervasive and eternal
things are permanent and impermanent at once (the neem sprouting, the bean turned to paste)
dharmāstikāya is everywhere and makes things move
adharmāstikāya makes all things stay
time produces both the instant and the long aeon
space gives room to all things
the soul joined to the body enjoys taste and the other senses
the atom of matter (புற்கலம்) is outer form and brings good and bad deeds
release is stopping the inflow of both kinds of deed and exhausting former deeds by experiencing their fruit
Vyasa, Kritakoti and Jaimini taught ten, eight and six means of knowledge
the truth of things must be grasped through the ten means of knowledge, perception through the unfailing 'uṇṭām neṟi'
perception is fivefold, through eye, ear, nose, tongue and body
valid perception requires soul, sense, mind, light, object and place free of fault and without doubt or error, and knows place, name, kind, quality and action

claims_rejected.why: Manimekalai's request 'நவை அறு நன் பொருள் உரைமினோ' is a question, not a claim
